protocol.winner_rule: Among candidates meeting every criterion: largest paired-improvement lower bound, then larger mean fraction, then gamma38.
protocol.missing_run_policy: All48x10 required; no exclusions or imputation. Missing/error output disables success and selection.
protocol.confidence_rules: Each gamma-versus-baseline claim is conjunctive. One-sided fraction/improvement/deltaV bounds at alpha=.025; original two-sided95% drift-equivalence intervals retained. Intervals are not advertised as jointly simultaneous across all constituents.
protocol.estimand: Arithmetic mean of seedwise fractions (Vlow-Vhigh)/Vlow; paired seedwise candidate fraction minus baseline fraction. Not ratio of means.
protocol.scope: Confirmation under prospectively amended v2 design; v1 screen verdict remains separately reported. Endpoint comparisons do not establish curve shape or a continuous stationary branch.

scope: Prospectively amended v2 endpoint validation; mean seedwise fractions, paired comparisons with Bonferroni2 one-sided alpha .025. Continuous stationary branch unconfirmed.
